	HOLTS radiator sealant seals and repairs leaks in your car's cooling system. This formula eliminates leaks within minutes and helps prevent further coolant loss, while dissolving deposits in the cooling circuit of passenger cars. A single 250ml bottle treats up to 21L of coolant, and you can use the formula in both winter and summer.
